hero: A privacy-first TD consumer banking assistant that triages urgent issues, finds official guidance, and routes you to the right specialist.

request.title: What do you need help with?
request.description: Examples include comparing checking fees, mobile app login trouble, suspicious Zelle activity, or credit card travel insurance.

product.title: Product or channel
product.description: Optional. Checking, savings, credit card, TD app, online banking, Zelle, branch, ATM, or insurance benefit.

urgency.title: Urgency

welcome.message: Tell me what you need help with. Do not share full account numbers, SSN, card numbers, PINs or one-time codes.
